== Sounio ==

{{works with|Sounio|v1.0.0-beta.6}}

Newton-Raphson root finding. Finds the root of f(x) = x² - 2 (i.e., √2).

<lang sounio>extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64
    fn fabs(x: f64) -> f64
}

fn f(x: f64) -> f64 { x * x - 2.0 }
fn df(x: f64) -> f64 { x * 2.0 }

fn newton_raphson(x0: f64, tol: f64, max_iter: i64) -> (f64, i64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: f64 = x0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < max_iter {
        let fx = f(x)
        if fabs(fx) < tol { return (x, i) }
        let dfx = df(x)
        x = x - fx / dfx
        i = i + 1
    }
    (x, max_iter)
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    let (root, iters) = newton_raphson(1.0, 0.000001, 100)
    println(root)    // ~1.4142135
    println(iters)   // ~4
}</lang>

Output:
<pre>1.4142135623730951
4</pre>

Note: Sounio requires the <code>Div</code> effect for division operations. The <code>Panic</code> effect covers potential runtime panics (e.g. array indexing). Both must be declared in the function signature.
